import os, subprocess, json, stat, datetime
from pathlib import Path
roots=["/","/home","/home/ubuntu","/home/ubuntu/.local","/home/ubuntu/.local/share","/opt","/srv","/root","/var","/var/cache","/var/lib","/var/www","/usr/local","/etc/systemd/system"]
print("AUDIT_UTC",datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
print("===DIRECTORY_INDEX_BEGIN===")
for root in roots:
 try:
  r=subprocess.run(['du','-x','--max-depth=1','-B1',root],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=105)
  if r.returncode not in (0,1): print("INDEX_ERROR",root,r.returncode)
  data=[]
  for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
   try:
    size,path=line.split("\t",1)
    if path==root:continue
    p=Path(path)
    if p.is_symlink():continue
    data.append((int(size),path))
   except (ValueError,IndexError):continue
  data.sort(key=lambda x:x[1])
  print('ROOT',root,'COUNT',len(data),'TOTAL',sum(x[0] for x in data))
  for size,path in data:
   print("DIR",size,path)
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:print("ROOT_TIMEOUT",root)
print("===DIRECTORY_INDEX_END===")
print("===TOP_LEVEL_FILES_WITH_SIZE===")
for root in ["/home/ubuntu","/root","/opt","/srv","/usr/local/bin","/usr/local/sbin"]:
 p=Path(root)
 try:
  arr=[]
  for child in p.iterdir():
   if not child.is_file() or child.is_symlink(): continue
   if root in ("/home/ubuntu","/root") and any(t in child.name.lower() for t in ("env","token","key","ssh","credential","secret")):continue
   st=child.stat()
   arr.append((child.name,st.st_size))
  print("FILES_ROOT",root,"COUNT",len(arr))
  for name,size in sorted(arr)[:45]:
   print("FILE",root+"/"+name,size)
 except PermissionError:print("FILES_RESTRICTED",root)
print("===DIRECTORY_INDEX_DONE===")
